mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_alarm (username, alarm_type, gubn_id, message, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{alarmType}, #{gubnId}, #{message}, CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), 'UTC', 'Asia/Seoul'))
mapper.select: SELECT alarm_id as alarmId, username, alarm_type as alarmType, gubn_id as gubnId, message, read_status as readStatus, CONVERT_TZ(created_at, 'UTC', 'Asia/Seoul') as createdAt FROM tbl_alarm WHERE username = #{username} AND read_status = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_alarm WHERE username = #{username} AND is_read = false
